CustomField.label: Pricing Review Override
CustomField.description: Sales Tools > Pricing Review View Checklist Tool: manual override of the pricing-review completion status. Blank = derive from whether answers exist; "Done"/"Not Done" force the status. Written by PricingReviewController.setReviewStatus.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Force the pricing-review status shown on the tool and dashboard. Leave blank to derive it automatically from whether a review has been completed.
